errors.message: The canonical document is not valid UTF-8 JSON.
errors.remediation: Encode the document as UTF-8 JSON and remove comments, trailing commas, and duplicate object keys.

errors.message: The canonical document violates the closed Modularity v1 schema.
errors.remediation: Use only declared fields and values from modularity-workspace.schema.v1.json.

errors.message: A module or composition-link identifier is duplicated.
errors.remediation: Assign a stable identifier that is unique within the workspace.

errors.message: A normative standard lacks a published repository, exact revision, or artifact path.
errors.remediation: Pin the published standard to its repository and full 40-character commit, or classify the draft as informative.

errors.message: A module source is not bound to an exact lowercase 40-character Git revision.
errors.remediation: Resolve the branch or tag to a reviewed commit SHA and record that immutable revision.

errors.message: A path is absolute, traverses a parent directory, or uses a non-portable separator.
errors.remediation: Use a forward-slash repository-relative path without '..' segments.

errors.message: A contract URI is exported more than once or a module-local contract identifier is duplicated.
errors.remediation: Keep one semantic owner for the contract and consume it through composition links.

errors.message: A composition link references a contract not exported by its provider module.
errors.remediation: Reference the exact URI exported by the link's 'to' module.

errors.message: A local contract artifact does not match its declared SHA-256 digest.
errors.remediation: Restore the canonical bytes or update the digest and compatibility version through the owning module.

errors.message: A composition link references an unknown module endpoint.
errors.remediation: Declare both endpoint modules or remove the stale link.

errors.message: A module links to itself.
errors.remediation: Keep internal composition inside the owning module or split it into independently owned modules.

errors.message: The module dependency graph contains a directed cycle.
errors.remediation: Extract a lower-level contract or move orchestration above the participating modules.

errors.message: A lower architectural layer depends on a higher layer.
errors.remediation: Invert the dependency through a lower-layer contract or move the consumer to the appropriate layer.

errors.message: A state domain has zero or multiple declared owner modules.
errors.remediation: Declare exactly one owner and model every derived copy as a projection.

errors.message: A state projection references a missing or mismatched owner.
errors.remediation: Point the projection at the sole owner of the same state domain.

errors.message: Authority is missing from an invocation or embedded in a non-invocation composition.
errors.remediation: Use one opaque authority reference only on an 'invoke' link and resolve it outside the DSL.

errors.message: The composition mode is incompatible with the provider contract or lacks generation provenance.
errors.remediation: Observe Twin traits, invoke POA capabilities with authority, and bind generated outputs to their generator and contract.

errors.message: A composition link consumes a retired module.
errors.remediation: Remove the link or migrate to a non-retired replacement.

errors.message: A composition link consumes a deprecated module while deprecation is disallowed.
errors.remediation: Migrate the dependency or explicitly accept deprecated modules for this bounded workspace.

errors.message: A Twin trait is consumed using a mode other than observation.
errors.remediation: Use 'observe'; expose a separate command capability for effects and invoke it through authority.

errors.message: A POA capability is not invoked through an external authority reference.
errors.remediation: Use 'invoke' with a separately resolvable grant or intent bound to the exact request and plan.

errors.message: A conformance command is not a non-empty argv array.
errors.remediation: Represent the executable and each argument as separate array elements; do not use shell strings.

errors.message: The analysis scope is empty, overlaps managed/generated classifications, or excludes an owned changed contract.
errors.remediation: Keep owned changed contracts visible, separate managed from generated paths, and use repository-relative glob patterns.

errors.message: An LLM input exceeds its declared budget, lacks provenance, or uses an unbounded whole-repository graph.
errors.remediation: Project ticket intent, changed contracts and deterministic findings into stable batches and validate every typed response before merging.

errors.message: Validation stopped because of an unexpected internal failure.
errors.remediation: Preserve the input and failure evidence, fix the validator, and rerun without treating the document as conforming.
